articles.summary: New campaign featuring football legend Clay Matthews highlights the transformation of the Caesars Sportsbook app through years of product enhancements Caesars Sportsbook has a confession to make heading into football season: it’s had some work done. Caesars Sportsbook Has “Had Some Work Done” Ahead of Football Season Quite a bit, actually. To spread the word, Caesars Sportsbook is launching a new advertising campaign featuring Clay Matthews, who appears noticeably different after “having some work done” himself. In a series of spots, Matthews proudly embraces a dramatically enhanced new look inspired by today’s makeover and “looksmaxxing” trends while showcasing a Caesars Sportsbook app that has gone through a transformation of its own. The spots use Matthews’ over-the-top makeover to spotlight how much the Caesars Sportsbook app has changed in recent years. Building on years of technology investments and product enhancements, Caesars Sportsbook enters football season with more ways
articles.title: Caesars Sportsbook Has “Had Some Work Done” Ahead of Football Season
